title: Pop! A Yellow Corn! 🌽 Thank You for My Food with Baby Ava | Thanksgiving Song | Crayon Babies
description:
Pop! A yellow corn jumps out of Baby Ava's harvest basket – then a red apple and an orange carrot! Sing along with Ava and learn to say "thank you" for yummy food in this cozy Thanksgiving song.

🎬 What happens in this video:
🌽 "Wow! Pop! A yellow corn!" – crunch, crunch!
🍎 Pop! A red apple! Apple, yum!
🥕 Pop! An orange carrot! Munch, munch!
💛 Hands on heart – thank you, thank you!
🤔 "Yummy food! What do we say?" – shout the answer: THANK YOU!
👋 Thank you for my food! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: saying thank you for our food • corn • apple • carrot • yellow, red, orange • thank you

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A sweet Thanksgiving sing-along for toddlers and preschoolers: Baby Ava sits in her pink high chair in the family kitchen, a harvest basket pops out a yellow corn, a red apple and an orange carrot, and she shows little viewers how to put their hands on their heart and say thank you for their food.
